January 31, 1940.
Morning Translation.

National Herald and Sin Wen Pao :-

HWO HWEI LOTTERY HEADQUARTERS IN WESTERN DISTRICT
BOMBED

At about 6 p.m. yesterday when a drawing
of the lottery was taking place at the Yih Kee (益記) Hwo
Hwei Lottery Headquarters conducted by Mao Ah-ziang (毛阿祥)
at Kung Yih Lee (公益里) on Robison Road, a large hand
grenade was hurled into the premises by some unknown persons.
The explosion injured more than 20 of the messengers who
had gathered at the place to learn the result of the drawing.
Upon learning of the incident, a party of
Japanese and puppet officers were rushed to the place where
they conducted a rigorous search, but no arrests were made.
The injured men were later removed to various hospitals for
treatment. Many of them are said to be in a critical condition.
Another bomb explosion took place at the
Yung Yuen (永源) gambling den at Yung An Fang (永安坊),
Bubbling Well Road, at about 9 p.m. yesterday when gambling
was going on full swing and the place was packed with gamblers.
Two hand grenades were said to have been thrown into the
place, resulting in the wounding of many gamblers, while some
received minor injuries. Great excitement prevailed. When
the Japanese and puppets arrived at the place, all the gambler
had already left. The injured gamblers were later removed
to hospital for treatment.

DS7 hao
DS
1/2

1940年1月31日。
晨间译件。

《国民新闻报》及《辛闻报》：-

西区华惠彩票总部遭炸弹袭击

昨日下午6时许，当毛阿祥（Mao Ah-ziang）在罗便臣路（Robison Road）公益里（Kung Yih Lee）经营的益記（Yih Kee）华惠彩票总部进行开奖时，数名不明身份者向场内投掷了一枚大型手榴弹。爆炸致使聚集在该处等待开奖结果的20多名信差受伤。获悉此事后，一队日本人和伪政权警官迅速赶至现场进行了严密搜查，但未实施逮捕。伤者随后被送往各家医院接受治疗。据称，其中许多人情况危急。

昨晚9时许，另一宗炸弹爆炸事件发生在静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）永安坊（Yung An Fang）的永源（Yung Yuen）赌窟内，当时赌博活动正酣，场内挤满了赌徒。据称有两枚手榴弹被投入该处，导致许多赌徒受伤，部分人受轻伤。现场一片混乱。当日本人和伪政权人员到达现场时，所有赌徒已逃离。受伤的赌徒随后被送往医院治疗。

January 31, 1940.    Afternoon Translation.    80398/41(C)
                                        Date   / 2   40

Crystal (晶報), a mosquito paper, published the following
article on January 30 :-

GAMBLING DENS IN WESTERN DISTRICT

    During the past few months many large gambling
dens have been established in the Western District and are
said to be all doing good business.
    Formerly the Asia Club (亞洲總會) at No. 65
Gordon Road was doing the best business among all gambling
establishments, but now it has been surpassed by the Chiu
Yuan (秋園) gambling den at No. 15 Jessfield Road,
because the latter is not so strict as the former in the
checking up of the membership cards of the visitors.
Moreover, callers to and from this gambling den are provided
with the convenience of free transportation by motor cars
with black number plates, belonging to six local motor car
garages. The cars provided by the Asia Club for the
conveyance of its clients are those of the Silver Taxi
Service. Though the callers are accorded this facility free
of charge, they are, however, required to undergo a strict
inspection of their membership passes.
    The Chiu Yuan gambling den was originally the
private residence of a Cantonese named Tan Hai-chiu (譚海秋).
It occupies a large area and is said to be the largest of
all gambling dens in the Western District. It is under the
management of a Westerner and many students of the University
of Shanghai and of Soochow Law College are said to be
making a living with this gambling den. It offers a game
called "Russian dominoes," which is not used in other
gambling establishments. It also provides tables for "Bah-
Chiu" games with paper cards. This game is said to be
attracting quite a large patronage.
    The third gambling den that enjoys a similar
notoriety as the above two is the one located at No. 626
Avenue Haig. It also occupies a large area but due to its
location which is rather too remote, it is less favoured
by the gamblers.
    Recently another gambling den known as Yih Loo
(亦廬) was established at No. 368 Avenue Haig. The Lien
Wei Loo (利匯廬) better known as the Hollywood (好萊塢)
is now rather too old, but it still does a good business in
the daytime. The Wei Loh Kung (會樂宮) which was newly
established on Great Western Road is conducted by the
proprietor of the Hollywood. It is well built and provides
a dancing floor and story-telling rooms, but its business
is not so prosperous as expected. The Yu Yuen Hotel
(豫園大飯店) at the corner of Bubbling Well and Tseng Roads
was opened only recently. It is not well furnished and yet
its business is quite above the average, presumably due to
convenience of communications.
    In addition to the above, there is also one
called the Monte Carlo which was originally known as the
Yung Sung Company (榮生公司). It is also doing a good
business, but the patrons of this den are mostly persons of
inferior class and therefore the establishment has not the
status of the Asia Club or the Chiu Yuan gambling den.

FILE

INDEXED BY
(S.H.) REGISTRY
DATE 1 / 2 / 40

1940年1月31日。    午后译件。    80398/41(C)
                                        日期   / 2   40

小报《晶报》（Crystal）于1月30日刊登了以下文章：-

西区赌窟

    在过去几个月里，西区开设了许多大型赌窟，据说生意都很兴隆。
    以前，戈登路（Gordon Road）65号的亚洲总会（Asia Club）在所有赌博场所中生意最好，但现在已被极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）15号的秋园（Chiu Yuan）赌窟超越，因为后者对访客会员证的检查不如前者严格。此外，往返该赌窟的客人可享受由六家本地汽车行提供的黑牌汽车免费接送的便利。亚洲总会为其客户提供的车辆则来自银色出租车服务（Silver Taxi Service）。虽然客人可免费享受此便利，但他们必须接受对其会员通行证的严格检查。
    秋园赌窟原为一名叫譚海秋（Tan Hai-chiu）的广东人的私人住宅。它占地面积很大，据说是西区所有赌窟中最大的一家。它由一名西人管理，据说许多沪江大学（University of Shanghai）和东吴法学院（Soochow Law College）的学生靠这家赌窟谋生。它提供一种名为“俄罗斯多米诺骨牌”的游戏，其他赌博场所不使用这种游戏。它还设有玩纸牌“八球”（Bah-Chiu）游戏的桌子。据说这种游戏吸引了相当多的顾客。
    第三家享有与上述两家同样恶名的赌窟位于海格路（Avenue Haig）626号。它也占地面积很大，但由于位置较为偏僻，不太受赌徒青睐。
    最近，另一家名为亦廬（Yih Loo）的赌窟在海格路368号开业。利匯廬（Lien Wei Loo），更广为人知的名字是好莱坞（Hollywood），现在显得过于陈旧，但白天的生意仍然不错。会乐宫（Wei Loh Kung）是大西路（Great Western Road）上新近开设的，由好莱坞的老板经营。其建筑精良，设有舞池和说书房间，但生意不如预期繁荣。豫園大飯店（Yu Yuen Hotel）位于静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）和曾路（Tseng Road）的拐角处，是最近才开业的。其设施并不豪华，但生意相当高于平均水平，大概是因为交通便利。
    除上述之外，还有一家名为蒙特卡洛（Monte Carlo）的赌窟，原名榮生公司（Yung Sung Company）。它的生意也不错，但该赌窟的顾客大多属于下层阶级，因此该场所不具备亚洲总会或秋园赌窟那样的地位。

归档

索引编制者
(S.H.) 登记室
日期 1 / 2 / 40

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. B. D. 2039/41(C)
Date 18 / 4 / 40

THE "SZE WEN CHI" AMUSEMENT RESORT

The following advertisement published by the "Sze
Wen Chi" (詩文集), a so-called amusement resort located
at No.478 Yu Yuen Road, appeared in the "Shanghai Daily
News" (上海日報), a mosquito paper, on January 17, 1940:-
"We have ordered from the United States a specially
made and delicate piece of machinery for amusement purposes.
It is rarely seen in Shanghai and is worthy to be recognized
as a most wonderful instrument for amusement. It can be
used to play games similar to the 'Hwo Gee Tai' (a kind of
gambling game). Moreover, it is accurate and reliable

September 12, 1941.

Western Shanghai Area Special Police -
notice re suppression of illegal business

On September 10, a circular notice was issued
by the Western Shanghai Area Special Police Force
reiterating the order concerning the suppression of
gambling dens and opium establishments in the area
under its jurisdiction. The notice states that since
inauguration, the Western Shanghai Area Special Police
has rigidly enforced the order issued by the Ministry
of Police and the Shanghai City Government in respect
of suppression of illegal enterprises as stipulated
in the agreement governing the policing of western
area. Although all known establishments have been
eradicated, unruly elements may escape the attention
of Police by secretly operating gambling and opium
establishments. The notice concludes by stating that
persons who conduct gambling in ballrooms will be
severely punished and those who grant lease of their
houses for the establishment of gambling and opium dens
will be dealt with accordingly.

It is learned, however, that gambling continues
in the premises of the former Winter Garden, 1505 Yu
Yuen Road, O.O.L.

上海西区特别警察 - 关于取缔非法营业的通知

9月10日，上海西区特别警察部队发布了一份通函通知，重申了其辖区内关于取缔赌窟和鸦片馆的命令。通知指出，自成立以來，上海西区特别警察严格执行了根据管辖西区警务协议规定的警察部和上海市政府发布的关于取缔非法企业的命令。虽然所有已知的场所已被铲除，但不法分子可能会通过秘密经营赌博和鸦片场所来逃避警方的注意。通知最后指出，在舞厅内进行赌博的人将受到严厉惩罚，出租房屋用于建立赌博和鸦片窝点的人也将受到相应处理。

然而，据悉，位于O.O.L.愚园路1505号的前冬园（Winter Garden） premises 内仍有赌博活动。

Gambling dens in the Western District - situation

The gambling den located at 75 Tifeng Road
opened in the afternoon of August 17, thus bringing
the number of gaming establishments operating in the
extra-Settlement roads area of the Western District

be one SUNG ZIANG LING (沈祥林). This place
was previously occupied by the Del-Monte Cafe and
was later chosen as the site of the "Chiu Lung"
Hotel, a gambling den which was prevented from
operating by the Japanese authorities.

OFF THE RECORD
NEWS BEHIND THE NEWS

Over A Tree
Yesterday's trouble at the Argentina Night Club, which was erroneously reported to be the result of a raid, actually developed when the servants of a Chinese in an adjoining compound felled a tree which crashed into the Argentina grounds, damaging some furniture.

The servants then arrived to cart off his tree, but a Russian watchman, named Sodnikoff, refused to let them have it unless he paid for the damage it had caused. The Chinese then left but soon returned with six policemen and a civilian who desired to beat up the watchman.

When the watchman indicated that he didn't care to be beaten up and the night club's book-keeper called the headquarters of the Western Area police force, the would-be "musclemen" disappeared.

The misunderstanding arose when the policemen were seen entering the compound of the Argentina Night Club, which conducts gambling openly, roulette, as well as Chinese dice games. The fact that the club is flourishing, gambling and all, in spite of Commissioner C.C. Pan's oft-repeated intention to close all such institutions, led to the report, when police were seen at the night club, that the Western District Police Chief had finally decided to transform words into action.

However, gambling will be on as usual at the Argentina tonight, making profits for its three owners—reported to be a Russian jeweler, another Russian, and a Rumanian dentist.

非正式记录
新闻背后的新闻

树梢之上
昨日阿根廷夜总会发生的纠纷，被误报为突击搜查的结果，实则起因是相邻院落中一名中国人的仆人砍倒了一棵树，树倒下砸入阿根廷夜总会场地，损坏了一些家具。

随后仆人们前来运走树木，但一名名叫 Sodnikoff 的俄罗斯看守拒绝让他们带走，除非赔偿造成的损失。该中国人随即离开，但很快带着六名警察和一名平民返回，意图殴打看守。

当看守表示不愿挨打，且夜总会的簿记员致电西区警察部队总部后，那些企图施暴的“打手”便消失了。

误解产生于人们看到警察进入阿根廷夜总会的院落，该夜总会公开进行轮盘赌以及中国骰子游戏等赌博活动。尽管 C.C. 潘处长多次重申要关闭此类机构，但该俱乐部包括赌博业务在内依然生意兴隆，这一事实导致当人们看到警察出现在夜总会时，便传出谣言称西区警察局长终于决定将言语转化为行动。

然而，今晚阿根廷夜总会的赌博仍将照常进行，为其三位所有者赚取利润——据报道分别是一名俄罗斯珠宝商、另一名俄罗斯人和一名罗马尼亚牙医。

JUL 5

SHANGHAI TIMES
JUL 5

Mayor Protests Operation
Of West Area Game Dens

Writes To Doyen Of Consular Body Requesting
Him To Take Action Against Foreigners
Owning And Running Establishments

Protesting the alleged function-
ing in the Western District of
Shanghai of several gambling
establishments owned by foreigners
enjoying extraterritorial rights
Mayor Chen Kung-po of Greater
Shanghai was reported last night to
have sent on Friday a letter to Mr.
Poul Scheel, Doyen of the Consular
Body, requesting him to notify all
foreign gaming house operators to
abide by the modus vivendi agree-
ment signed between the Chinese
authorities and the Shanghai
Municipal Police.

The complete text of the letter
follows, according to the Central
Press:

"With reference to prohibit
gambling practice in the Western
Area, you were requested to notify
foreign residents of different
nationalities in Shanghai to observe
the regulations of the signed modus
vivendi agreement—stop gambling
and cease to indulge in similar
enterprises.

"Now, there are foreign nationals
of questionable characters opening
establishments for gambling pur-
poses in the Western Area. The
most noted ones are the "Argentine"
and "St. George" and a few other
secret dens operated under disguise,
by foreigners who rely on being
foreign nationals, so disobey Chinese
laws.

Police In Difficulty

"The police of the Western Area
has extreme difficulties to handle
such cases because it is necessary
to obtain first a search warrant
from the concerned Consulate before
any search of premises can be effect-
ed. These bad foreigners usually
depend on their extraterritorial pri-
vileges to carry on evil practices so
that a situation is created whereby
new gambling dens begin to operate
soon after old ones are raided.
Therefore, the gambling evil in the
Western Area can never be stopped,
and the police in the said area can
never carry out orders from this office

Foreigners To Be Arrested

"It is hereby decided that hence-
forth orders will be issued to the
Western Area Police to arrest
gamblers irrespective of their
nationalities and close down dens.
The concerned Consulates will be
notified later for transfer of
offenders of foreign nationality.
This method will facilitate the
functioning of the said prohibition
law and will help restore order.

"You are cordially invited to
transmit this information to par-
ties concerned. Thanking you for
your kind attention."

7月5日

《上海泰晤士报》
7月5日

市长抗议西区赌场运营

致领事团团长写信要求其采取行动对付拥有并经营这些场所的外国人

据昨晚报道，大上海市长陈公博就上海西区几家由享有治外法权的外国人拥有和经营的赌博场所 allegedly 运作一事提出抗议，并于周五致信领事团团长 Poul Scheel 先生，要求其通知所有外国赌场经营者遵守中国当局与上海公共租界工部局警务处签署的临时协议。

据中央通讯社报道，信件全文如下：

“关于禁止西区赌博行为一事，曾请阁下通知在上海的不同国籍外籍居民遵守已签署的临时协议规定——停止赌博并 cease 从事类似企业。

“现在，有一些品行可疑的外籍国民在西区开设赌博场所。其中最著名的是‘阿根廷’和‘圣乔治’，以及其他几家由外国人伪装经营的秘密赌场，这些外国人倚仗其外籍身份，从而违犯中国法律。

警方陷入困境

“西区警方在处理此类案件时面临极大困难，因为在进行任何场所搜查之前，必须首先从相关领事馆获得搜查令。这些不良外国人通常依赖其治外法权特权进行邪恶勾当，从而导致一种局面，即旧赌场被突击搜查后不久，新赌场又开始运营。因此，西区的赌博恶习永远无法制止，该地区的警方也永远无法执行本办公室的命令

逮捕外国人

“兹决定，此后将命令西区警察逮捕赌徒，不论其国籍，并关闭赌场。稍后将通知相关领事馆移交外籍罪犯。此方法将有助于上述禁令法律的执行，并有助于恢复秩序。

“诚邀阁下将此信息转达有关各方。感谢阁下的关注。”

JUL 5 1941
To Curb Gambling
Mayor Writes
To Scheel For
Cooperation

As a further step toward the realization of the policy to suppress gambling and similar evils in the western district of Shanghai where some gambling houses owned and operated by foreigners are said to be still carrying on their business under the protection of extraterritoriality, Mayor Chen Kung-po sent a letter yesterday to Mr. Poul Scheel, Senior Consul-General, requesting him to notify all foreign residents to observe the terms of the modus vivendi signed between the Chinese authorities and the Shanghai Municipal Council, the Central Press reported last night. The full text of the letter, according to the news agency, is as follows:—

"With reference to prohibit gambling practice in the Western Area you were requested to notify the foreign residents of different nationalities in Shanghai to observe the regulations of the signed Modus Vivendi—stop gambling and cease to indulge in similar enterprises.

"Now, there are foreign nationals of questionable characters opening establishments for gambling purpose in the Western Area. The most noted ones are "Argentine" and "St. George" and few other secret dens operating under disguise rely on foreign nationals to disobey the Chinese laws.

Extreme Difficulties

"The police of the Western Area has extreme difficulties to handle such cases because it is necessary to obtain first a search warrant from the concerned consulate before to effect any search at the premises. These bad foreigners usually depend on this privilege to drag along their evil practice so it creates a situation that new gambling dens begin to operate soon after raids are over. Therefore the gambling evil in the Western Area can never be stopped and the police in the said area can never carry out orders from this office.

"It is hereby decided that henceforth orders will be issued to the Western Area Police to arrest the gamblers irrespective of their nationalities and close down the dens. The concerned consulates will be notified later for transfer offenders if gamblers of foreign nationals are involved, thus it would expedite the functioning of the said prohibition law and bringing the matter in order.

"You are cordially requested to transmit this communication to parties concerned and thanks for your kind attention."

为遏制赌博

谢尔请求合作

据中央社昨晚报道，为进一步落实在上海西区取缔赌博及类似恶习的政策——据悉，一些由外国人拥有和经营的赌馆仍在治外法权的庇护下继续营业——陈公博市长昨日致函总领事保罗·谢尔（Poul Scheel）先生，请其通知所有外籍居民遵守中国当局与上海公共租界工部局签署的《临时协定》条款。据该通讯社称，信函全文如下：——

“关于禁止在西区进行赌博活动一事，曾请阁下通知在上海的各国籍外籍居民，遵守已签署的《临时协定》之规定——停止赌博并 cease 从事类似行业。

“目前，西区有一些品行可疑的外国人开设赌场。其中最著名的是‘阿根廷’（Argentine）和‘圣乔治’（St. George），另有少数其他秘密窝点伪装经营，依仗外籍身份违抗中国法律。

极度困难

“西区警方在处理此类案件时面临极大困难，因为在对场所进行搜查之前，必须先获得相关领事馆签发的搜查令。这些不良外籍人士通常依赖这一特权延续其非法勾当，导致每次突击搜查结束后，新的赌窝很快又重新开始运营。因此，西区的赌博恶习永远无法根除，该地区的警方也永远无法执行本办公室的命令。

“兹决定，此后将命令西区警方逮捕赌徒，不论其国籍为何，并关闭赌窝。若涉及外籍赌徒，随后将通知相关领事馆移交罪犯，以此加速上述禁赌法令的执行，使事态纳入正轨。

“恳请阁下将此函转达有关各方，并对阁下的关注表示感谢。”

JUN 1941

Move To End Farren's,
Eventail Gaming Made

Revealing that the first part of
the campaign to close down gam-
bling dens in the Western district
had been complete I, Mr. Pan Dah.
Commissioner of ne Western Area
Special Police force, declared that
the next move to close foreign-
operated establishments is now
underway and is expected to show
results within the next few days.
An official request, it is learned.
was made by Mayor Chen Kung-
po of the Shanghai Special Muni-
cipality to the Shanghai Consular
Body, urging the foreign consula:
representatives to curb gambling
dens still operating in the "outside
roads" by foreigners who en-
joy extrality rights.
A joint gambling enterprise
which was being sponsored by the
Chinese dens closed down last
week by the authorities. was est-
ablished at Del Monte's but re-
mained open only for one day.
Some new construction work
which had been carried out at the
premises were seen being taken
down this morning, and it is be-
lieved that the den will not open
again.
Two Still Open
Meanwhile, the gambling estab-
lishments at Farren's and the
Eventail night club remained
open last night, despite orders
issued by Mr. Pan Dah, commis-
sioner of the Western Area
Special Police Force, for the
closing of all gambling dens in
areas under his control by the
end of May.
The two dens were the only
ones that defied orders of the
police chief, it will be noted. On
June 3, Mr. Pan declared to the
Evening Post that he would see
to the closing of the gambling
establishments within 48 hours.

Difficult Task

In an interview with the Even-
ing Post this morning, Mr. Pan
declared that although the two
dens failed to close down last
night, he did not expect them to
remain long in business. Mr. Pan
indicated that immense difficulties
were confronting him in the
closing of the two dens.
Three of the five major dens,
the Chateau International
the China Club, and the Union
Club, were closed on May 31, it
will be recalled.
pages.zh:
8039A/44-8).0

1941年6月

采取行动终结法伦氏（Farren's）
及扇形夜总会（Eventail）的赌博活动

西区特别警察部队总监潘达（Pan Dah）先生透露，关闭西区赌馆行动的第一阶段已经完成，他宣布，下一步关闭由外国人经营的场所的行动正在进行中，预计在未来几天内见效。据悉，上海特别市市长陈公博已向上海领事团提出正式请求，敦促外国领事代表遏制仍由享有治外法权的外国人在“越界筑路”地区运营的赌馆。

一家由上周被当局关闭的中方赌馆赞助的联合赌博企业曾在德尔蒙特（Del Monte's）设立，但仅营业了一天。今早有人看到该场所的一些新建工程正在拆除，人们相信该赌窝不会再次开业。

两家仍然开放

与此同时，尽管西区特别警察部队总监潘达先生已下令在5月底前关闭其管辖区域内的所有赌馆，但法伦氏（Farren's）和扇形（Eventail）夜总会的赌博场所昨晚仍然开放。

值得注意的是，这两家赌窝是唯一违抗警察局长命令的场所。6月3日，潘先生向《晚报》（Evening Post）表示，他将在48小时内确保这些赌博场所关闭。

艰巨任务

在今早接受《晚报》采访时，潘先生表示，虽然这两家赌窝昨晚未能关闭，但他预计它们不会长期营业。潘先生指出，他在关闭这两家赌窝时面临着巨大的困难。

回想起来，五大主要赌馆中的三家——国际大酒店（Chateau International）、中国俱乐部（China Club）和联合俱乐部（Union Club）——已于5月31日关闭。

NORTH CHINA DAILY NEWS
June 6 1947

Police Chief Declares
Gambling Ended

Mayor Chen Kung-po, of the
Greater Shanghai Special Municipal
Government forwarded an official
letter on Wednesday to the Senior
Consul of the Consular Body in
Shanghai asking the latter to request
foreign authorities concerned to co-
operate with Chinese authorities in
closing foreign-managed gambling
houses in the Western District, it was
learned from official Chinese quart-
ers yesterday. All Chinese-owned
gambling houses in the same district,
including the biggest ones, were re-
cently ordered closed by local Chi-
nese authorities.
No details of the Mayor's letter
were disclosed but it was learned
that it explained that the establish-
ment of gambling houses in the dis-
trict by foreign interests was con-
trary to the agreement signed be-
tween the Shanghai Municipal Council
and the Chinese city regime prior to
the formation of the Western District
Special Police Bureau.
Mr. C. C. Pan, Commissioner of the
special police recently declared that
he would see to that that there would
be no revival of gambling activities
in his district following the closure
of Chinese gambling houses. He
made the statement following rum-
ours that the biggest gambling house
in Avenue Haig would reopen under
a foreign name, forming a syndicate
with six other gambling houses al-
ready closed.

《华北每日新闻》
1947年6月6日

警察局长宣布
赌博已终结

据中方官方人士昨日获悉，大上海特别市政府市长陈公博于周三向上海领事团首席领事发送了一封公函，请后者要求有关外国当局与中国当局合作，关闭西区由外国人管理的赌馆。同一区域内所有华人拥有的赌馆，包括最大的几家，最近已被中国地方当局下令关闭。

市长信函的细节未予披露，但据悉信中解释称，外国势力在该区设立赌馆违反了西区特别警察局成立之前上海公共租界工部局与中国市政当局签署的协议。

特别警察总监潘CC先生（Mr. C. C. Pan）最近宣称，在华资赌馆关闭后，他将确保其辖区内不再有赌博活动死灰复燃。此前有谣言称，海格路（Avenue Haig）最大的赌馆将以外国名义重新开业，并与另外六家已关闭的赌馆组成辛迪加。

Gambling dens in the Western District
--------------------------------------

The "East Asia Club" (東亞俱樂部), a
small gambling den located at House 79 Yah Sze Loong,
off Ferry Road, which recently came into existence,
was closed on June 20 in view of possible action by
the Western Shanghai Area Special Police Authorities.

The East Asia Charity Association, Lane 1032,
25 Yu Yuen Road, previously in charge of supervision
of gaming establishments in the Western District, has
ceased functioning, subsequent to the recent closure
of the gambling dens in the extra-Settlement roads
area.

According to information obtained, endeavours
are being made by "guards" of the defunct gambling dens
in the Western District to resume gaming activities in
co-operation with their former employers. They
attempted to use the premises of the "Argentina" club,
626 Avenue Haig, but their efforts are said to have
been temporarily frustrated in view of firm attitude
on the part of Mayor Chen Kung Poh.

C O N F I D E N T I A L

June 3, 1941.

GAMBLING DENS IN THE WESTERN DISTRICT - SITUATION.

The "Chiu Lung" Hotel, a new establishment at
452 Avenue Haig, did not open on June 2, in consequence
of an order from the Western District Japanese Military
Police. This hotel was prepared to commence operations
at 3 p.m. June 2, when verbal instructions were received
from Major Tsukimoto ( ) of the Western District
Japanese Gendarme ordering it to refrain from functioning.

The decision against the "Chiu Lung" Hotel is re-
ported to have been adopted by the Japanese Authorities
ostensibly due to a complaint made by the Deutscher Gar-
ten Klub, 454 Avenue Haig, through the medium of the
German Consulate, but the financial problem is believed
to be the real cause for the action. It is stated that
according to previous negotiations, the new establishment
was permitted to open on condition that it pay the various
fees hitherto borne by the defunct three gambling dens,
namely, the Loh Kuo Hotel, China Club and Union Club. How-
ever, the "Chiu Lung" Hotel is said to have agreed to pay
only half of the sums previously paid by the three dens.

Endeavours are now being made by the Management
of the "Chiu Lung" Hotel to reach an understanding with
the Japanese Authorities for its establishment.

Following closure, the employees of the China Club,
29 Tifeng Road and the Union Club, 6 Tifeng Road, have been
paid off. The China Club employees were paid $80:00 each,
whilst those in the employ of the Union Club were paid $40:00
each.

- - - - • O • - - - -

IW/.
pages.zh:
机 密

1941年6月3日。

西区赌馆 - 情况。

位于海格路（Avenue Haig）452号的新设场所“九龙”酒店（"Chiu Lung" Hotel），因西区日本宪兵队的命令，未于6月2日开业。该酒店原准备于6月2日下午3时开始营业，此时接到西区日本宪兵队队长塚本少校（Major Tsukimoto）（原文不清）的口头指示，命令其不得营业。

据报道，日本当局对“九龙”酒店作出的决定，表面上是因为德国花园俱乐部（Deutscher Garten Klub，海格路454号）通过德国领事馆提出投诉，但财务问题被认为是采取此举的真正原因。据称，根据之前的谈判，新场所获准开业的条件是支付此前由三家已倒闭赌馆承担的各种费用，即罗国酒店（Loh Kuo Hotel）、中国俱乐部（China Club）和联合俱乐部（Union Club）。然而，据说“九龙”酒店仅同意支付这三家赌馆此前支付金额的一半。

目前，“九龙”酒店的管理层正努力与日本当局就其开业事宜达成谅解。

关闭后，位于提丰路（Tifeng Road）29号的中国俱乐部和提丰路6号的联合俱乐部的员工已被解雇并结清工资。中国俱乐部的员工每人获得80.00美元，而联合俱乐部的员工每人获得40.00美元。

- - - - • O • - - - -

IW/.

June 2, 1941

Gambling dens in the Western District - Situation

The following gambling dens in the Western
District ceased functioning during the night of
May 30/31.

(1) Loh Kuo Hotel - 346 Avenue Haig
(2) China Club - 29 Tifeng Road
(3) Union Club - 6 Tifeng Road

The new establishment - "Chiu Lung" Hotel -
is expected to open this afternoon, June 2, at
452 Avnue Haig. It is reported that the new
establishment will pay a daily tribute of $20,000.00
to the Japanese Military Police and a similar sum to
the East Asia Charity Association, Lane 1032, 25
Yu Yuen Road for the relief of the "unemployed"
guards of the defunct gambling dens. It is also
learned that the "Chiu Lung" Hotel is permitted to
operate for a period of three months, after which
the matter will again be reviewed by Mayor Chen
Kung Poh in conjunction with the Japanese Authorities.

-o-o-o-o-o-o-o-

NOTE :
June 3, 1941

With regard to the above Special Branch report,
it was at first reported that the above premises had been
raided on the morning of June 2. Later, however, it was
ascertained that no actual raid had taken place but two
Japanese Gendarmes in plain clothes had entered the
premises and inspected the grounds with the result that
the gambling did not start as expected.

JM.

Gambling dens in the Western District - Situation.
------------------

According to information obtained, the three
gambling dens now operating in the Western District,
O.O.L., will amalgamate into one establishment and will
function in the form of a club. The amalgamation is
reported to take place in the near future, possibly at
the end of May or the beginning of June, 1941.

It is stated that LEE SHIH CHUN (李士群),
Minister of Police of the Nanking Government, has
instructed the gambling den conductors through the
medium of WOO SZE PAO (吳士寶), to make necessary
preparations for the amalgamation and to operate the
club at a new venue. However, there is a likelihood
that the premises of the Loh Kuo Hotel, a gambling den
at 346 Avenue Haig will be used as the site of the new
club, if no other suitable premises can be found.

It will be remembered that the three gambling
dens were ordered by Mayor Chen Kung Poh to close down
during the middle of the current month, but they continue
functioning through the efforts of WOO SZE PAO. The
Mayor has insisted on the suppression of the gambling
dens in the Western District as a step towards the
elimination of evils in that area apart from upholding
his prestige. He is said to have appealed to Mr. WANG
CHING WEI in this connection. However, LEE SHIH CHUN
was of the opinion that the immediate closing down of
those gambling dens in the extra-Settlement roads area
will affect the "livelihood" of the members of the
Special Service Group as far as the financial problem
is concerned. The Minister of Police is reported to

The following three gambling dens continue

(3) Union Club            6 Tifeng Road.

authorities. It is learned that these three gaming
establishments pay a total sum of $1,000,000.00 per
month to the Western Shanghai Area Special Police

who reported the matter to the management of the den.
Whilst being removed, the bomb exploded causing injury
to the guard. The victim is now receiving treatment
in the Red Cross Hospital, Avenue Haig.

received at the 2nd Division, 15 Jessfield Road, reporting
that a bomb had exploded and injured one of the employees.

C.I.Blenkinsop, Officer i/c 2nd Division attended
and learned that, at 5.05 p.m. 3/4/41, a cigarette type
bomb was found in the main gambling room by a guard named
Sheng Shing (陳清) age 36, Kompo, who picked it up
with the intention of placing it in a bucket of water.

However, it exploded when picked up, and injured
him on both hands.

He was taken to the Red Cross Hospital, 363 Avenue
Haig, where he was treated for 'Multiple' shell wounds of
both hands' and allowed to go.

No information could be obtained regarding the
person or persons who placed the bomb in the room, and
no bomb fragments could be found.

Crime Branch informed and conducting enquiries.

Mr. Clissold, D.C. informed.

1941年4月4日。

特别股报告第1号

‘提丰路29号华人总会炸弹爆炸案。’

1941年4月3日下午5时10分，杰斯菲尔德路15号第二分区接到电话报告，称发生炸弹爆炸并致一名雇员受伤。

第二分区主管 C.I. Blenkinsop 警官到场调查，获悉1941年4月3日下午5时05分，一名名叫盛兴 (Sheng Shing) [注：原文拼音为Sheng Shing，括号内中文为陳清，此处依原文翻译并保留括号内容]、36岁、籍贯金波 (Kompo) [音译] 的警卫在主赌博室发现一枚香烟型炸弹，他捡起炸弹意图将其放入一桶水中。

然而，炸弹在捡起时爆炸，导致其双手受伤。

他被送往海格路363号红十字会医院，因“双手多处弹片伤”接受治疗后被允许离开。

未能获得关于放置炸弹者的任何信息，也未找到炸弹碎片。

已通知刑事侦缉处并进行调查。

已通知副督察长 Clissold 先生。

CONFIDENTIAL
March 30, 1941.
Gambling dens in the Western District - Situation.

The Hwa Loh Hotel, a gambling den located at
792 Yu Yuen Road ceased to function on March 29, 1941.
Ostensibly the establishment is said to have closed as
a result of the decision of Mayor Chen Kung Poh to
suppress vice in the Western District, but actually
it was due to slackness of business.
There are three leading gambling dens operating
at present in the extra-Settlement roads area namely :-
1. Loh Kuo Hotel      346 Avenue Haig.
2. China Club         29 Tifeng Road.
3. Union Club          6 Tifeng Road.

FILE

MAKAROFF Michael Vassilievich，俄罗斯人，职业为司机兼机械师，1901年8月11日出生于俄罗斯彼尔姆（Perm）。他于1928年5月从满洲抵达上海。

他在阿根廷俱乐部（Argentina Club）担任发牌员。

LYALIN Nicholas Arsentieyich，俄罗斯人，已婚，职业为餐馆老板，1888年2月16日出生于俄罗斯彼得格勒（Petrograd）。他于1930年12月从大连抵达上海。

他在阿根廷俱乐部（Argentina Club）担任餐厅及舞厅经理。

ARGENTINA CLUB.
626 Avenue Haig.Tel:22679.

The Argentina Club is a fashionable Casino recently
opened at 626 Avenue Haig.
The proprietors of the Club are the following:-
L.S. FLISHER, Russian Jew.
B.N. KAPELMAN, Russian Jew
Dr. L. HECHTMAN, Rumanian, Jew.
The lower floor consists of restaurant, ball room and
several lounges. The upper floor of the Club is reserved
for Roulette and other forms of gambling. No gambling
has yet been conducted in the Club owing to some
difficulties experienced by the proprietors in
obtaining a license from the Municipality of Greater
Shanghai.
The capital of the Club is $ 100,000.00. L.S.Fleisher
having put up $ 50,000.00 and B.N. Kapelman and Dr.L.
Hechtman - $ 25,000.00 each.
Antecedents of the proprietors and personnel of the
Club are as follows:-
FLISHER Leonid Semenovich, Russian Jew, married,
professional croupier, was born on March 12th., 1902 at
Station Yrekte of the North Manchurian Railway. He
received his education at the Horvath's College in
Harbin from which he graduated in 1921. In 1923 he
acquired Soviet Citizenship and left Harbin for
Irkutsk, Soviet Russia and remained there for about a
pages.zh:
阿根廷俱乐部（ARGENTINA CLUB）。
海格路626号。电话：22679。

阿根廷俱乐部是一家最近在海格路626号开业的时尚赌场。
该俱乐部的业主如下：-
L.S. FLISHER，俄籍犹太人。
B.N. KAPELMAN，俄籍犹太人。
L. HECHTMAN 博士，罗马尼亚籍犹太人。
底层设有餐厅、舞厅和几个休息室。俱乐部上层专用于轮盘赌及其他形式的赌博。由于业主在向大上海市政府申请许可证时遇到一些困难，俱乐部目前尚未进行任何赌博活动。
俱乐部资本为100,000.00美元。其中 L.S. Fleisher 出资50,000.00美元，B.N. Kapelman 和 L. Hechtman 博士各出资25,000.00美元。
俱乐部业主及人员的背景如下：-
FLISHER Leonid Semenovich，俄籍犹太人，已婚，职业发牌员，1902年3月12日出生于北满铁路伊列克特站（Station Yrekte）。他在哈尔滨的霍尔瓦特学院（Horvath's College）接受教育，并于1921年毕业。1923年，他获得苏联国籍并离开哈尔滨前往苏联俄罗斯的伊尔库茨克，在那里停留了约一

pages.en:
a year,returning to Manchuria in 1924. He arrived in
Shanghai from Manchuria in February 1929 and is known
to have since been connected with various local
gambling establishments either in the capacity of a
croupier and/or proprietor.

There is reason to believe that the notorious Elly
WIDLER is a secret partner of the Argentina Club,his
interests being represented by Fleisher. It is believed
that Fleisher's share of the capital involved -$50,000.00
is in reality Widler's money.

KAPELMAN Boris Naftalievich,Russian Jew,married,was
born on August 19th.,1900 at Verhne-Udinsk,Transbaikal
Province of Russia. He received his education at the
Commercial School at Chita,Russia from which he
graduated in 1917. He left Chita for Harbin together
with his parents in 1917 where he resided until 1923
and then left for Tientsin. He arrived in Shanghai from
Tientsin in 1930. He deals in jewellery and is the
partner of a jewellery firm " Bijou Beraha "at 225,
Grosvenor House,Route Cardinal Mercier. He resides at
1327/31 Rue Lafayette.

L. HUCHTMAN;Rumanian Jew,married,Dental Surgeon. His
wife is of French nationality and they reside at Apt.112,
Medhurst Apts.,934 Bubbling Well Road. He has been
residing in Shanghai for about 7 years.

GONIKSHTOCK Jacob Isaevich,Russian Jew,was born on
September 15th.,1900 at Baralevichi,Russia. He received
his education at the Russian College in Irkutsk,Russia.
He arrived in Harbin from Soviet Russia in 1927 and
pages.zh:
年，于1924年返回满洲。他于1929年2月从满洲抵达上海，据悉此后一直以发牌员和/或业主的身份参与当地多家赌博场所的活动。

有理由相信，臭名昭著的 Elly WIDLER 是阿根廷俱乐部的秘密合伙人，其利益由 Fleisher 代表。据信，Fleisher 所涉及的50,000.00美元股本实际上是 Widler 的资金。

KAPELMAN Boris Naftalievich，俄籍犹太人，已婚，1900年8月19日出生于俄罗斯外贝加尔省上乌丁斯克（Verhne-Udinsk）。他在俄罗斯赤塔的商业学校接受教育，并于1917年毕业。1917年，他与父母一起离开赤塔前往哈尔滨，在那里居住至1923年，随后前往天津。他于1930年从天津抵达上海。他从事珠宝生意，是位于梅白尔路（Route Cardinal Mercier）格罗夫纳大楼（Grosvenor House）225号的“Bijou Beraha”珠宝公司的合伙人。他居住在拉斐德路1327/31号。

L. HUCHTMAN；罗马尼亚籍犹太人，已婚，牙科外科医生。其妻子拥有法国国籍，他们居住在静安寺路934号麦赫斯特公寓（Medhurst Apts.）112室。他在上海居住已约7年。

GONIKSHTOCK Jacob Isaevich，俄籍犹太人，1900年9月15日出生于俄罗斯巴拉列维奇（Baralevichi）。他在俄罗斯伊尔库茨克的俄罗斯学院接受教育。他于1927年从苏联俄罗斯抵达哈尔滨，并

shortly upon his arrival renounced his Soviet Citizenship

SECRET
March 15, 1941.

Gambling dens and opium hongs in the Western District

Despite verbal instructions recently given by the
Shanghai City Government to the effect that all gambling
dens operating in the Western Area, O.O.L. would have to
close, the following four large gambling dens continue to
operate :

1. Loh Kuo Hotel          346 Avenue Haig
2. China Club             29 Tifeng Road
3. Hwa Loh Hotel          798 Yu Yuen Road
4. Union Club             6 Tifeng Road.

（批：Commissioner of Police,
S.I.
Information
J. Sharman
A.C. (Sp. Br.)）

According to information received, conductors
of these four gambling dens have reached an understanding
with Woo Sze Pao (吴世保), Chief of the Defence Corps
and the Special Service Group Headquarters, 76 Jesefield
Road, and the Japanese Military Police, whereby the latter
would support the conductors against any action adopted by
the City Government Authorities. Woo is said to have
told Col. Loo Ying, Commissioner of the City Government
Police, of the attitude of the gambling dens conductors,
and urged the former to impress upon Mayor Chen Kung Poh
that any drastic attempts on the part of the City
Government to close the dens may result in unpleasant conse-
quences. It is reported that with the support of Woo Sze
Pao and the Japanese Military Police, the conductors of the
gambling dens are prepared to offer armed resistance if a
forcible attempt by the City Government authorities is
made to close them. To meet any emergency a number of
firearms have been stored in readiness at the China Club,
29 Tifeng Road.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
CRIME AND SPECIAL BRANCH
15 MAR 1941）

（印：FILE）

However, with a view to reaching an amicable settle-
ment the conductors have appealed to the City Government
pages.zh:
机密
1941年3月15日。

西区赌场与鸦片烟馆

尽管上海市政府最近口头指示，所有在越界筑路区（O.O.L.）西区运营的赌场必须关闭，但以下四家大型赌场仍在运营：

1. 六国饭店          海格路346号
2. 华人俱乐部         提丰路29号
3. 华乐饭店          愚园路798号
4. 联合俱乐部         提丰路6号。

（批注：警务处处长，
特别情报处。
信息
J. Sharman
助理处长（特别分部））

据收到的消息，这四家赌场的经营者已与吴世保（Woo Sze Pao，音译）达成谅解，吴系杰斯菲尔德路76号保卫团及特别服务组总部主任，并与日本宪兵队达成协议，由后者支持经营者对抗市政府当局采取的任何行动。据说吴已向上海市政府警察局局长陆英（Loo Ying，音译）上校通报了赌场经营者的态度，并敦促前者向市长陈公博强调，如果市政府试图强行关闭这些赌场，可能会导致不愉快的后果。据报道，在吴世保和日本宪兵队的支持下，如果市政府当局试图强行关闭赌场，赌场经营者准备进行武装抵抗。为了应对紧急情况，中国俱乐部（China Club），提丰路29号，已储存了一批枪支以备不时之需。

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处
罪案与特别分部
1941年3月15日）

（印章：档案）

然而，为了达成和解，经营者已向市政府

pages.en:
- 2 -

Authorities. It is stated that the former agreed to
close their establishments for a short period provided
that they be allowed to reopen them after the new Police
Force is established in the Western Area. For permission
to continue operations the conductors have suggested to
pay a large sum of money to the Shanghai City Government.
Both suggestions Mayor Chen Kung Poh disapproved of and
said that he intended to bring about the closing of the
gambling dens which operated in the area under his control.
Further information to hand is to the effect that
the conductors of the four gambling dens now operating have
each agreed to raise the daily "protection fees" from
$12,000.00 to $15,000.00. This protection fee is paid to
the East Asia Charity Association, Lane 1032 , 25 Yu Yuen
Road, of which Mr. Yamaki is in charge. This decision was
made with a view to furthering the support given by the
Japanese authorities.

---

There are 42 opium hongs in the Western District, C.O.L.
They have rented houses in Nantao preparatory for removal
if instructed to remove by the City Government. They are,
however, making efforts to secure permission from the Japanese
and City Government authorities to continue business at their
present addresses.

-----
pages.zh:
- 2 -

当局提出上诉。据说，前者同意暂时关闭其场所，条件是在西区建立新的警察部队后允许其重新开业。为了获得继续经营的许可，经营者建议向上海市政府支付一大笔款项。陈公博市长驳回了这两项建议，并表示他打算关闭在其管辖区域内运营的赌场。进一步的消息称，目前运营的四家赌场的经营者已同意将每日“保护费”从12,000.00美元提高到15,000.00美元。这笔保护费支付给位于愚园路25号1032弄的东亚慈善协会，该协会由山木先生（Mr. Yamaki，音译）负责。做出这一决定是为了进一步争取日本当局的支持。

---

在越界筑路区（C.O.L.）西区有42家鸦片烟馆。他们已在南市租赁房屋，以备在市政府下令搬迁时迁移。然而，他们正在努力从日本和市政府当局那里获得许可，以便在现址继续营业。

-----

803919/41(C)-O
March 10, 1941.

Gambling dens in the Western District - situation

The Shanghai City Government recently notified
the gambling dens operating in the Western District
to cease functioning. The Police Bureau was instructed
by Mayor Chen Kung Poh to take action against those
dens in the event of their refusing to obey the order.
According to information received, it was proposed that
on the evening of March 7 to have the reserve unit of
the City Government Police raid the gambling establishments.
The conductors of the gambling dens appealed
to the Japanese Military Police. The Japanese Gendarmerie,
it is reported, decided against the proposal of the
City Government Police to close down the gambling
establishments. As a result, the City Government did
not proceed with the proposition.

The following four large gaming establishments
are still operating at the following places :

1. Loh Kuo Hotel          346 Avenue Haig.
2. China Club             29 Tifeng Road.
3. Hwa Loh Hotel          792 Yu Yuen Road.
4. Union Club             6 Tifeng Road.
pages.zh:
803919/41(C)-O
1941年3月10日。

西区赌场 - 局势

上海市政府最近通知在西区运营的赌场停止运作。陈公博市长指示警察局在赌场拒绝服从命令的情况下采取行动。据收到的消息，原计划于3月7日晚由市政府警察后备队突袭这些赌博场所。赌场经营者向日本宪兵队求助。据报道，日本宪兵队决定反对市政府警察局关闭赌博场所的提议。因此，市政府未执行该计划。

以下四家大型赌博场所仍在以下地点运营：

1. 六国饭店          海格路346号。
2. 华人俱乐部         提丰路29号。
3. 华乐饭店          愚园路792号。
4. 联合俱乐部         提丰路6号。

pages.en:
9-3-41. Am 177
Cheng Yien Pao :-
THE GAMBLING DENS IN THE WESTERN DISTRICT
On the afternoon of March 7 the Loh Kuo
(六國), the China Club (華人俱樂部), the Hwa Loh (華樂)
and other gambling dens and several scores of opium dens
received telephone messages from a certain party to the
effect that preparations be made by the managements and
that as soon as formal instructions were given, the dens
be closed immediately.
It is not known as to whether they will
be allowed to move to Nantao after they have closed down
in the Western District.

9-3-41. Am 177
郑延宝（Cheng Yien Pao，音译）:-
西区赌场
3月7日下午，六国（Loh Kuo）、华人俱乐部（China Club）、华乐（Hwa Loh）及其他赌场以及数十家鸦片烟馆收到某方的电话通知，大意是管理层应做好准备，一旦收到正式指令，立即关闭赌场。
目前尚不清楚他们在西区关闭后是否被允许迁往南市。

Hwo ei Lottery Headquarters ordered to cease

Headquarters at House 12 San Loh Tsung (三樂邨),

function secretly.

February 24, 1941.

Chinese-American Daily News publishes the following report:-

REPORTED POSTPONEMENT OF SUPPRESSION OF LEADING
GAMBLING DENS IN WESTERN DISTRICT

Recently reports have been current to the
effect that all big gambling dens in the Western District
will close down prior to the inauguration of the Special
Police Force.

According to well-informed circles, three
or four big gambling dens are continuing to operate despite
the fact that several small gaming houses have already closed
their doors.

It is also learned that these gambling dens
have postponed the date of their formal closure till August
so that the several thousand employees of these gambling dens
may have sufficient time to find employment.
pages.zh:
1941年2月24日。

《中美日报》刊登如下报道：-

据报道西区主要赌窟取缔行动延期

近期有传闻称，在特别警察部队成立之前，西区所有大型赌窟都将关闭。

据消息灵通人士称，尽管数家小型赌场已经关门，但仍有三四家大型赌窟继续营业。

另获悉，这些赌窟已将正式关闭日期推迟至八月，以便这几千名赌窟雇员有足够时间寻找工作。
